name: opus55-longrun
description: Long-run workflow for Opus 5.5, based on 'Getting the Most Out of Opus 5.5' (Addy Osmani, Sep 2026): delegation briefs with done-criteria, subagent fleet audits, merge-blocker reviews, consistency checks, verified research, design exclusion lists, prompt linting, a destructive-command confirmation hook, and Stop hooks for checklist enforcement and blocked-on-me notifications.
